title: Is the First AI-Designed Drug Finally Arriving? Takeda's Zasocitinib Beats Sotyktu Head-to-Head
summary: Takeda's zasocitinib beat Sotyktu in a head-to-head Phase 3 psoriasis study, turning AI-enabled drug design into a real commercial test.
